title: Tammi Lisson VP Sales, Service & Support at RBC Royal Bank Centres
description: We are here to "promote" the capabilities of global "Customer Experience" or "Service Leadership" professionals around the world.  Welcome to our Youtube channel! Feel free to comment and contribute, and share this video on your channel.  Tammi Lisson (VP, Sales, Service & Support Contact Centres at RBC Royal Bank) talks about her experience at the Execs in the Know 2013 Customer Response Summit in beautiful Bonita Springs, Florida.

asr.full_text: Yeah, actually it's one of the things that's great about it because it's contact center. Professionals from every industry. So between airlines, entertainment, financial services, there was everything. And so that in and of itself is interesting because everybody has a very different approach. And so in financial services we tend to be much more conservative, other industries not. So conservative and it's just interesting to hear how they approach it. It was interesting to go in and see other contact centre environments, both the GM one. In Austin and Sony here, different perspectives, different parts of the operation, but absolutely. Phenomenal to see and I find that really good because you're actually seeing it in action.
